2f3aeac.summary: Toggles a card's ambush state: shows hidden ambush visuals for the opponent, or reveals the card, restores stats and triggers its Ambush ability.

2f3b20c.summary: Handles reactions to damage dealt: syphon, poisonous, rage, cruelty, ecstasy, damage triggers, ambush reveal, low-life invulnerability and concussive stun.

2f3b858.summary: Returns whether this card's ecstasy trait should trigger given its current health and the health it would have after damage.

2f3bba0.summary: Resolves a card being played: fires play triggers, checks combo and summon effects, records turn played, and triggers swarm with a matching right neighbour.

2f3c08c.summary: Spawns the swarm visual effect at this card's position and wires a callback to finish the swarm buff on another unit.

2f36870.summary: Destroys the reflected frame object on the card UI if one exists.

2f3c32c.summary: Processes the tide trait: plays an animation and spawns an ephemeral copy of this card in hand with copied effects and a decremented tide counter.

2f3debc.summary: Processes the companion trait: plays an animation and adds an ephemeral companion copy to hand with a decremented companion counter.

2f3e0c0.summary: Returns whether this card should spawn a companion, either via the companion trait with a related card or a positive counter.

2f3bd94.summary: Fires unit-summoned triggers (other unit summoned, this unit summoned, faith, support, uprising) depending on who was played.

2f3e1e0.summary: Resolves a card's active ability, handling loading, oath double-triggers, and then refreshes trait icons on the card UI (inlined helpers included).

2f2f6b8.summary: Removes the drop pod trait with camera shake and UI refresh, then runs the death check on the unit.

2f3eae8.summary: Removes the tainted (duplicitous) trait, refreshes UI text, then runs the death check on the unit.

2f3eb10.summary: Activates the survivor trait: restores health, removes the trait, plays effects, fires the Survivor trigger and marks survivor spent.

2f3ed70.summary: Turns the card into a remnant with fixed health and removes all its current traits.

2f3ef58.summary: Turns the card back from a remnant and refreshes the health and armour displays and ambush visibility.

2f3f34c.summary: Triggers the sacrifice trait: plays effects, fires Sacrifice, and notifies all other units and both hands.

2f3f4c4.summary: Triggers the codex ability of this card against a target, defaulting to itself.

2f3fa10.summary: Checks whether a unit is dead and handles drop pod destruction, survivor, remnant transformation or marking it waiting to die.

2f3ffa0.summary: Queues a backlash death action for the unit, recording the turn it died.

2f401c4.summary: Queues an action that transforms this card into the warlord's starting weapon, logging an error if none is defined.

2f40388.summary: Queues a unit death action for non-hero cards; for warlords it only logs that no death action is added.

2f404bc.summary: Marks the unit as waiting to die if it is in play, otherwise logs a warning.

2f405ec.summary: Sets the card state to transforming, logging warnings or errors depending on its current state.

2f40778.summary: Handles a minion's death: hunt mark damage and healing, death/other-death triggers, unstable, and slay-style ability triggers by death type.

2f40ca0.summary: Resolves a dead card action: triggers death effects, slay, requiem and sacrifice, or ends the battle if the warlord has died.
